content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binds the Customer anywhere in this agreement — and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms it.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ", "recruit" and "personnel", plus review of the General (§ 30), Customer Responsibilities (§ 12) and Confidentiality (§ 16) sections, show no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant binding Customer (or either Party). § 12.3 goes further and expressly records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed. No finding is raised on § 12.4 (a restriction on Vendor), which benefits our party.
